description: This file declares the GpxParser class, which provides static methods to parse GPS data from .gpx files or strings and extract GPS fixes into a provided data structure.

classes.name: GpxParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse GPX files and strings to extract GPS fixes.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a .gpx file at the specified file path and extracts GPS fixes into the provided fixes array. Returns true if successful, false otherwise, and sets an error message if applicable.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a string containing GPX data and extracts GPS fixes into the provided fixes array. Returns true if successful, false otherwise, and sets an error message if applicable.
